research_question: How do architecture and initialization affect discrimination, calibration and transfer of a development-selected decision threshold?
data: Retain audited original training and test cohorts; divide prior validation by patient proxy into model-selection and calibration partitions.
selection: Choose architecture by mean model-selection AUROC across completed seeds. Average its seed probabilities. Never use test metrics to choose.
calibration: Fit one positive scalar temperature to calibration logits; choose Youden threshold on calibration predictions; freeze before test.
comparison: Report every planned trial and both raw/calibrated scores; paired group-bootstrap intervals for selected comparison; no test-driven changes.
budget: 270 minutes including audit and training, approximately 30 minutes reserved for final evaluation/export; early stopping allowed. Queue/setup are separate.
limitations: Previously inspected test set: exploratory, not confirmatory
No guarantee of paper acceptance or clinical validity
